PistonBlockEntity normal and forced finish postProcessState

prior_mcp_validation.scope: Full MCP library suite before final optional receipt fields and native observation-interval metadata; final bridge tests and public native workflow cover the subsequent changes.

boundaries: stone_stairs, cobblestone_stairs, quartz_stairs, smooth_quartz_stairs; complete dry states only.
Native matrix covers declared cases, not every circuit or stair state. Shape/inert callbacks and hidden histories are not directly observed.
Readback uses standard commands with command permission, no companion-mod addition, no block writes or world tick freeze.
Current whole-region predicate uses compressed Air comparisons; 8880 cells and 30000 command characters are preflight ceilings. Dense or fragmented regions may need smaller bounds.
Earlier retained device captures use their recorded confirmation versions; the current compressed single-command path is exercised by the retained public trial.
Snapshot fingerprints retain original JSON encoding; not canonical after Rust reserialization or cryptographic server attestation.
No atomic write transaction, hidden runtime reconstruction, unconditional teardown or automatic repair guarantee.
Retired v15 contexts require fresh review; no checkpoint migration.
Other stair materials, waterlogging, panes, fluids/items/entities and direct piston crushing remain outside scope.
Failed captures remain failures. No full workspace test suite; workspace Clippy and the listed targeted regressions were run.
